name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Practice and accessibility assist: holds a jump press for a few physics ticks and fires it on the first tick you can act. Turn it off (mode 1) for any run you plan to submit for verification.

buffer-mode.name: Buffer Mode
buffer-mode.description:
How long a press that arrives while you cannot act is held and then fired on the first tick you can.
<cy>1 - Off</c>: vanilla input.
<cy>2 - Low</c>: up to 4 ticks.
<cy>3 - Medium</c>: up to 6 ticks.
<cy>4 - High</c>: up to 10 ticks.
A tick is one physics step of the game. At the usual 240 ticks per second, 4 / 6 / 10 ticks is about 17 / 25 / 42 ms. <cr>Recommended OFF for runs submitted for verification.</c>

cycle-key.name: Cycle Mode Hotkey
cycle-key.description: Cycles Off > Low > Medium > High while a level is open. Can be rebound to a keyboard key, mouse button or controller button.

show-confirmation.name: Show Confirmation Toast
show-confirmation.description: Briefly shows the new mode and its buffer size when you change it with the hotkey or the pause-menu button.

show-hud-indicator.name: Show HUD Indicator
show-hud-indicator.description: Shows a small BUFFERED label at the top of the screen while a press is waiting to fire.

debug-log.name: Debug Logging
debug-log.description: Logs every buffered press, fire and a ticks-per-second measurement to the Geode log. Use it to verify the window sizes on your setup.
